title: Say Palasyo na Salming ya Salming
intro: Imadyin mo pay arawin dalin ya mayaman tan marakep ya ditan et say agew so dadayewen imbes ya say Manamalsa to. Sinmabi so sakey a sulat ya walay tawag ya ag nayarin ibaliwala, tan ginmapo so biahe ya amaarap ed sakey a korte ya mas baleg nen say antokaman ya anengneng nensaman. Diman, say ilusyon et napatnagan na sakey a datal ya makapalikdo ed mata, tan say sakey a bekta na kalinew so manguman ed amin.
clues: Nan-ari ak ed sakey a maaligwas a bansa ya saray totoo to et manpapasnok ed banwa imbes ya diad si Allah.
Akaawat ak na sakey a marakep a sulat ya ontatawag ed siak ya ag ko ipaatagey so sarilik no ag ingen manpasakop ak ed si Allah.
Kinonsulta ko so konseho ko tan pinilik nin unona so diplomasya, ya angipawit ak na regalo pian nasubok so angibaki.
Linma ak ed Sulayman, tan say mismon trono ko so inpresenta ed siak ya akasalimbengan pian nasubok so pakabidbiran ko.
Linmoob ak ed atagey a palasyo ya say makinis a salming a datal to et inisip kon aralem a danum.
Inyabawag ko so panagpasakop ko ed si Sulayman ed si Allah, say Katawan na saray mundo.

identity.label: Siopa ak?
options: Say agin bii nen Musa
Say asawa nen Abu Lahab
Say Asawa nen Nuh
Bilqis, say Manuley ed Saba
Zulaikha, say asawa nen Al-Aziz

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Inakmon na baleg a sira ed dalem na dayat
Asakitan lapud dakel a taon ya sakit tan inkaandi na pamilya
Ingganggan ya ibagat so inad-aro ton anak diad kugip
Sinubok na akaamot a trono tan say palasyo na salming
Ibantak ed mandarlang ya apoy pian deralen iray talintao
trial.answer: Sinubok na akaamot a trono tan say palasyo na salming

location.label: Manunan Elemento
options: Say Biong ya impaalagey ed tapew na danum
Say ungib a salimbengan na saray naugip
Say kristal ya datal na palasyo (Sarh)
Say Ilog Nilo nen panaon na impaway
Say apoy ya imparaan na saray managdayew ed talintao
location.answer: Say kristal ya datal na palasyo (Sarh)

outcome.label: Pansumpalan
options: Inakmon na dalin a kaiba iray kayamanan ko
Nansiansia ya agmakapanisia tan aderal a kaiba iray totook
Inmabuloy ed si Sulayman ed si Allah, say Katawan na saray mundo
Nalner ed dayat legan ya uusilan iray mananisia
Nagmaliw a bato lapud impansumlang ed Sabaton
outcome.answer: Inmabuloy ed si Sulayman ed si Allah, say Katawan na saray mundo

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَـٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ ۖ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ ۚ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ
verse: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allāh]. (27:42)
